title: The Work of a Force
body: A stick is displaced by $$\vec{D}=(-7.9\hat{j}-4.2\hat{k})\, \text{cm}.$$ The third dog pulls with force $$\vec{F}_3=(5.0\hat{i}+12.5\hat{j})\,\text{N}.$$ How much work $$W_3=\vec{F}_3\cdot\vec{D}$$ is done by the third dog? Express your answer in both $$\text{N}\cdot\text{cm}$$ and joules.
